topic: Like a river that washes us five times a day

learn.en: Five times a day the mu'adh-dhin calls Muslims to worship Allah alone. We pray facing the qiblah — the Ka'bah in Makkah.
learn.title: The call to prayer

learn.en: We can pray alone or together in jama'ah (congregation) — in the masjid, at home, at work or even in a garden.
learn.title: Anywhere

learn.en: The Prophet ﷺ asked: if a river ran by your door and you washed in it five times a day, would any dirt remain? That is like the five prayers, which wipe away sins.
learn.title: A river at your door

learn.en: Walking to the masjid, every step adds a good deed and erases a bad one. Praying in jama'ah is 27 times better than praying alone!
learn.title: Every step counts

learn.en: The five prayers: Fajr (dawn), Dhuhr (midday), Asr (afternoon), Maghrib (sunset) and Isha (night). Try to always pray on time.
learn.title: Five prayers

order.en: Put the five prayers in order through the day

quiz.en: Praying in jama'ah is better than praying alone by…
True or false? Each step to the masjid adds a good deed.
True or false? We can only pray inside a masjid.

think.q: The five prayers are like washing in a river five times a day. How do you feel after you pray?
think.a: Clean, calm and close to Allah.

parents.summary: The five daily prayers wash away sins like a river; praying in jama'ah is 27 times better; Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha.
parents.tip: Pray one prayer together as a family jama'ah today.
